title: 盈米 MCP 授权
description: 填写盈米 MCP API Key 以启用基金与市场数据查询。Key 仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your Yingmi MCP API Key to enable fund and market data access. The key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and is never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel_en: How to get an API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 粘贴从盈米 MCP 页面获取的 API Key
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the API Key from the Yingmi MCP page
fields.description: 登录盈米 MCP 开通服务后复制个人 API Key，将作为 Query 参数 apiKey 注入 MCP 请求。
fields.description_en: Sign in to Yingmi MCP, enable the service, then copy your personal API Key. It will be injected as the apiKey query parameter.
